intro.fr: SUPERHOT: Mind Control Delete se joue en multiworld Archipelago grâce à un APWorld communautaire, distribué hors de l'installation officielle.
intro.en: SUPERHOT: Mind Control Delete can be played in an Archipelago multiworld through a community APWorld, distributed outside the official install.

text.fr: Création du dépôt GitHub Temperz87/SUPERHOT_MCD_Archipelago, qui héberge l'APWorld de SUPERHOT: Mind Control Delete.
text.en: The GitHub repository Temperz87/SUPERHOT_MCD_Archipelago, home of the SUPERHOT: Mind Control Delete APWorld, is created.

text.fr: Publication de la version 0.01, la plus récente au 21 octobre 2026 (2 versions publiées).
text.en: Version 0.01 is released, the latest as of October 21, 2026 (2 versions released).

text.fr: SUPERHOT: Mind Control Delete figure dans le tableur communautaire des APWorlds, qui recense les mondes jouables hors de l'installation officielle d'Archipelago.
text.en: SUPERHOT: Mind Control Delete is listed in the community APWorlds spreadsheet, which tracks the worlds playable outside the official Archipelago install.
